<description>
This PR continues the ongoing effort to enforce IWYU warnings.

See [Developer Notes](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/blob/master/doc/developer-notes.md#using-iwyu).

Based on https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36805 and https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36807.
</description>

<commits>
0a35cfc34d Enclose all header content in include guards

c385c1ff18 lint: Require all code in a header to be inside its include guard

Flag any non-comment line before `#ifndef` or after `#endif`.

86296b1bf6 refactor: Introduce `node/node_id.h` header

Two identical declarations of `NodeId` make it ambiguous for static
tools such as IWYU which header should provide the symbol. Move the
declaration into a header of its own.

`net.h` re-exports it, since `NodeId` is part of its interface.

1d62aaa23b refactor: Fix `#include`s in `net` and `node/eviction` modules

The `#include`s added to other files replace ones they previously
received transitively via `net.h` and `node/eviction.h`.

f2e0f6149c iwyu: Fix warnings in `src/test/fuzz` and treat them as errors
</commits>
